gaps.explanation: Gap 940,000 is the Street Fund bond payment. The p4 governmental funds statement counts it in Debt service Principal 1,070,000 (Debt Service Fund 130,000 + Street Fund 940,000; total expenditures 2,351,842). The Street Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule (p10, printed p22) prints it under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES as 'Bond payments (940,000)' (net other financing sources 605,000 = Bond proceeds 1,545,000 - 940,000), not among expenditures (Street total expenditures 824,950). It is in detail as an other-financing line 'Bond payment' -940,000 (Street Fund, p10). Schedule 1,411,842 + 940,000 = 2,351,842. The schedule prints the payment in another section than the statement; as printed, no fix.

p7 proprietary statement (modified cash basis) Total operating expenses 528,696 include Depreciation 108,842 (Water 50,178, Sewer 58,165, Garbage 499) and no capital outlay. The budgetary schedules print no depreciation but the Sewer Fund schedule (p18) prints Capital outlay 6,755 (capitalized on the statement). Detail = 528,696 - 108,842 + 6,755 = 426,609 (exact); gap 102,087 = 108,842 - 6,755. All other object lines tie to p7. No fix.
